== Method summary ==
- 2D surface interpolated with scipy.interpolate.RectBivariateSpline on the 89×69 grid (kx=ky=3).
- κ_perp(s) from least-squares quadratic fit of 13 tube_scan samples per point; ν_perp via manifest scale ν_cm = 95·√κ/√m_perp.
- Free-energy profile G(s,T) = ΔV + ΔZPE_perp + RT·Δln(1−exp(−hν_perp/RT)) with quantum-oscillator transverse partition function.
- k_local = (kB·T/h)·(ν_R/ν_‡)·exp(−ΔV_fwd/RT) [classical harmonic TST at conventional saddle].
- k_optimized = (kB·T/h)·exp(−ΔG_max(T)/RT) [CVT].
- κ_corridor(T) = 1 + ∫₀^{V_fwd} P(E)·exp(−E/RT) dE / [RT·exp(−V_fwd/RT)] (κ ≥ 1 by construction).
- 1D corridor action ξ_corridor(E) = 1.24·∫_{forbidden} √(2 m_long (V−E)) ds.
- 2D action subtracts a Skodje–Truhlar perpendicular reduction 0.5·1.24·∫ ℏω_⊥/(V−E) ds on the forbidden region, clipped to [0, ξ_corridor].
- Transmission P(E) = 1/(1+exp(2ξ)).
- crossover_T_K = linearly-interpolated T where log10(k_enhanced)=log10(k_local); null if no flip in [177.5, 947.5] K.
- Isotope scaling: m_long,c = longitudinal_mass_scale × 1 amu; ν_perp,c = ν_perp/√transverse_mass_scale.
- log10_KIE_sct_vs_light = log10(k_enhanced,light,T) − log10(k_enhanced,case,T) at the same T.

== Validations passed ==

- transmission_profile.csv: action_2d ∈ [0, action_corridor]; transmission_corridor ∈ [3e-17, 1.0]; transmission_2d ∈ [0, 1.0]; action_ratio ∈ [0, 1].
- path_samples.csv: 3840 rows = 64 × 60; path_step consecutive 0..59 within each energy_id.
- isotope_effects.csv: 36 rows = 3 × 12 with case_ids {light, transfer_D, framework_D}.
- isotope_transmission_profile.csv: 192 rows = 3 × 64; energy_id 0..63 within each case.
- diagnostics.json: valid JSON (NaN → null); 3 case entries; all required keys present.
- rate_plot.png: valid 8-bit RGBA PNG, IHDR+IDAT+IEND, 16.4 KB.

== Key assumptions & limitations ==
- matplotlib is unavailable in the sandbox; rate_plot.png is rendered via a stdlib-only PNG writer (zlib+struct) with an embedded 5×7 bitmap font.
- crossover_T_K = null for all three cases (physically correct, not a bug): ν_‡ > ν_R (1580 > 1314 cm⁻¹) and ΔG_max > ΔV_fwd together keep k_enhanced above k_local at every T in [177.5, 947.5] K; V_fwd/R ≈ 5753 K is the high-T limit where the crossover would eventually occur.
- action_2d is clipped to [0, action_corridor] for numerical stability at deep-tunneling energies where the Skodje–Truhlar 1/(V−E) weighting diverges.
- E_grid is uniform ΔE = V_fwd/63 = 0.7591 kJ/mol; energy_id 0..63. Tunneling tail above V_fwd is folded into the κ denominator analytically as P(V_fwd)=1·RT·exp(−V_fwd/RT).
- Isotope scaling assumes the manifest frequency_scale = 95 cm⁻¹/√(kJ/mol)/coord calibration is mass-scaling-free in mass-weighted reduced coordinates; mass enters via m_perp ∝ × transverse_mass_scale (ω² = κ/μ_red).
- All required constants are inlined from system_manifest.json — no other reference or metadata files were read.
